quests.title: The Number Kingdom Adventure
quests.description: Help the Number King organize his magical kingdom by mastering numbers and operations!

story.introduction: Welcome, brave adventurer! The Number Kingdom is in chaos - numbers are scattered everywhere! The Number King needs your help to restore order to his magical realm.

steps.title: The Place Value Palace Mystery
steps.narrative: The palace guards have mixed up the treasure chests! Each chest has a number, but they're in the wrong rooms. Help organize them by place value.

problem.question: In the number 3,456, what is the place value of the digit 4?
problem.explanation: The digit 4 is in the hundreds place, so its place value is 400. Remember: from right to left we have ones, tens, hundreds, thousands!

steps.title: Building the Addition Bridge
steps.narrative: The bridge connecting two villages has broken! Use addition to calculate how many stones are needed to rebuild it.

problem.question: Village A has 1,234 stones and Village B has 2,567 stones. How many stones do they have together?

steps.title: The Multiplication Maze Challenge
steps.narrative: To escape the magical maze, you must solve multiplication puzzles at each turn!

problem.question: A wizard has 8 magic potions, and each potion has 7 ingredients. How many ingredients does he have in total?
problem.explanation: 8 × 7 = 56. You can think of it as adding 7 eight times: 7+7+7+7+7+7+7+7 = 56!

steps.title: Defeat the Fraction Dragon
steps.narrative: The mighty Fraction Dragon guards the kingdom's treasure! Only by mastering fractions can you defeat this beast and save the kingdom!

problem.question: The dragon has eaten 3/8 of the kingdom's cookies. If there were 24 cookies originally, how many cookies did the dragon eat?
problem.explanation: To find 3/8 of 24: (3 × 24) ÷ 8 = 72 ÷ 8 = 9 cookies. The dragon ate 9 cookies!

quests.title: The Fraction Kingdom Quest
quests.description: Master the magical art of fractions and help the Fraction Princess restore her kingdom!

story.introduction: The Fraction Kingdom is in turmoil! Evil forces have scattered fraction pieces across the land. Only a true Fraction Master can reunite them and restore peace.

steps.title: Climbing the Fraction Basics Tower
steps.narrative: Princess Fractiona shows you the Tower of Understanding. Each floor teaches you about fractions!

problem.question: Look at this pizza divided into 8 equal slices. If 3 slices are eaten, what fraction represents the eaten portion?
problem.explanation: 3 slices out of 8 total slices = 3/8. The top number (numerator) shows parts taken, bottom number (denominator) shows total parts.

steps.title: The Equivalent Fractions Forest
steps.narrative: In the magical forest, fractions that look different are actually the same! Find the equivalent fractions to unlock the secret path.

problem.question: Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2?
problem.explanation: 3/6 = 1/2 because if you divide both top and bottom by 3, you get 1/2. They represent the same amount!

steps.title: The Fraction Addition Cave
steps.narrative: Deep in the cave, you find fraction crystals that must be combined. Add them together to create powerful magic!

problem.question: Add these fraction crystals: 1/4 + 2/4 = ?
problem.explanation: When fractions have the same denominator, just add the numerators: 1/4 + 2/4 = (1+2)/4 = 3/4!

steps.title: Duel with the Fraction Wizard
steps.narrative: The evil Fraction Wizard challenges you to a final duel! Solve this complex fraction problem to defeat him and save the kingdom!

problem.question: The wizard's spell requires 2/3 of a magic potion. If you have 3/4 of the potion, do you have enough? How much more or less do you have?
problem.explanation: Compare 3/4 and 2/3: 3/4 = 9/12, 2/3 = 8/12. Since 9/12 > 8/12, you have 1/12 more than needed!

quests.title: The Geometry Castle Adventure
quests.description: Explore the mysterious Geometry Castle and unlock its shape-shifting secrets!

story.introduction: The ancient Geometry Castle holds the secrets of shapes and angles. Navigate through its magical rooms and become a Geometry Guardian!

steps.title: The Triangle Treasure Room
steps.narrative: Sir Shapealot leads you to a room full of triangular treasures. Count the sides and angles to unlock the treasure chest!

problem.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
problem.explanation: A triangle always has exactly 3 sides and 3 angles. That's why it's called a 'tri-angle'!

steps.title: The Rectangle Riddle Hall
steps.narrative: In the Rectangle Hall, you must solve riddles about four-sided shapes to proceed to the next chamber.

problem.question: What makes a rectangle special compared to other four-sided shapes?
problem.explanation: A rectangle has 4 right angles (90 degrees each). Opposite sides are equal, but not all sides need to be equal like in a square.

steps.title: The Circle Chamber Mystery
steps.narrative: The final chamber is perfectly round! Solve the circle mystery to claim the Geometry Crown.

problem.question: If a circle has a radius of 5 cm, what is its diameter?
problem.explanation: The diameter is always twice the radius. So if radius = 5 cm, then diameter = 2 × 5 = 10 cm!

steps.title: Battle the Shape-Shifting Guardian
steps.narrative: The castle's guardian can change into any shape! Identify all the shapes it transforms into to prove you're worthy of the Geometry Crown!

problem.question: The guardian transforms into a shape with 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. What shape is it?
problem.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. It's a special type of rectangle where all sides are the same length!
